lines.english: And then…
We're finally at the middle of March, where the signs of winter have all but faded away as the sunlight gradually shines stronger and the air gradually warms up.
"It's finally time, huh…"
"Time sure flies, doesn't it?"
"…Well, we knew this day would come."
Today is the day of the examination for the second wave of admissions to Seisen University.

It's been three weeks since Koharu decided to take this exam… and after spending an impossibly short amount of time preparing for it, we now find ourselves standing right in front of Seisen University's main gate.
Compared to the first admission term, I bet there's barely even a tenth of the number of examinees heading in the same direction we are and with the same attitude as us.
But with the number of accepted applicants being only a tenth of that, it wouldn't be weird at all to say that the path to entry is super-duper tight. …Though I wish I could've worded that better.
"Well, in any case, just do your best. The only thing I can do is just pray for you, though."
"What are you talking about? The fact that I can stand here today full of confidence is all thanks to you, Senpai."
"…Good to know, then."
I'm confident that I've done everything I could.

But in the end, I can only speak for what we managed within the limited time we had. If someone were to ask me if I'd be able to achieve a result that would overcome these conditions, I'd argue that it was a ridiculous endeavor to begin with.
"Do you have your exam admission card? Did you properly pack all of your stationery? I suppose you should also turn off your phone now…"
"There's no point in saying all that when it comes to me, Senpai."
"You're… right…"
In any case, there's really nothing for me to worry about since she's just not someone who would make such careless mistakes, much like myself.
…However, the fact that there's nothing to worry about is the very thing fanning my uneasiness, as I find myself stuck in a loop of contradictory thoughts.
"Alright, then, I should be heading in soon."
"Yeah…"
Leaving my worries aside, with light but powerful steps, Koharu marched through the main gate of Seisen University.
"…Good luck!"
She really does seem much more confident and relaxed compared to my own trembling voice calling out to her.
"…Um, Senpai?"
As soon as Koharu reached the gate, she turned around to face me once again in a precise, clockwise fashion.
"Thank you… for everything you've done for me up until now!"
Her voice rings across the vicinity as she bows her head deeply to me.
"I, I… absolutely won't forget it! I won't forget everything you've given me, Senpai!"
"Koharu…"
"…I won't forget any of it."
How do I put this… that show of gratitude sounded far too exaggerated, and far too powerful for someone who's simply going to take an exam.
"…You're exaggerating. Remember that there's still a lot we'll have to do our best in. This isn't the time to feel relieved."
"…Of course."
That's why I can't obediently accept such humble words. I can only concentrate on what I'm facing right now.
"I'll pick you up later. Call me when the exam is over."
"…I will."
"See you."
For some reason, the sight of Koharu looking at me with such seriousness in her eyes caused me discomfort, so I quickly turned around and hurried off.
All while I attempt to drive out the thought of why despite her relaxedness, she still carried an air of tragic resolve about her.
"…Senpai."
"…Goodbye."
"Ah, Mom? It's me. …Yeah, I just finished."
"The result… yeah, I did what I could. I have no regrets."
"…I really am sorry for everything, I've asked for so many unreasonable things. I'll pay you back the exam fees. Don't worry, I have money left over from work."
"I can't do that… I need to set things right. Even if I fail, I don't have any intention to rely on my family."
"…Ah～ let's drop this topic for now. Let's discuss it in detail after I get home."
"Yeah, I'm coming home right now. …There's nowhere I need to be anyway."
"Eh? Really? I can ask for anything? Then, umm…"
"Ah…"
"That's a relief… So you do know who I am."
"W-Well, I have seen you once before, after all."
"Ah, you mean on the video of my performance during the school festival? Now, that's embarrassing… What a shame that such an awful performance still remains to this day."
"You don't have to feel all that nervous. …Well, I guess it's natural to be on alert when a stranger approaches you."
"N-No, you're not a stranger… I know about you, Ogiso-senpai! …I actually know a lot about you."
"But this is the first time we've properly met, right? Nice to meet you. I'm Ogiso Takahiro's older sister, Setsuna. Thank you for looking after my younger brother all this time."
"…I'm Sugiura Koharu. U-Umm, so…"
"I'm really sorry for acting so brazenly…"
"N-Not at all… but how do you know about me?"
"Takahiro said you're having your entrance exam today. So I thought I'd finally have a chance to talk to you."
"I-I don't really understand what you mean."
"I'm sorry, perhaps it'd be better if we did this at a later date? Still, I just couldn't wait."
"T-That's not what I meant…"
"Hm?"
"Ogiso-senpai… Umm… How much do you know about me…?"
"Just how much do you know about what I've done…"
"Takahiro consulted me about you. He told me about a girl in his class who seemed to be incredibly sad."
"I just couldn't think of you as a stranger after that. And so I wanted to talk to you at least once, no matter what."
"What do you… mean by that…?"
"Can I tell you about something that happened in my past? It's a very old story, from a time when I was still in middle school and hadn't enrolled in high school yet."
"Middle school…?"
"I… received a confession during my third year of middle school."
"Well, that's not unheard of."
"…It happened to you, Sugiura-san?"
"…I have nothing to say about that."
"In the end, we failed to make up even when graduation arrived… I chose Houjou High through the process of elimination. …Because it was the only place everyone else was not going to."
"So, I entered Houjou and I changed the way I've been interacting with people up until then. After that I didn't get too close with my friends and always maintained a small distance."

"If I got closer with them, I might have ended up getting completely ostracized because of some little thing. …That's why I thought it'd be best to avoid getting close to them from the very beginning."
"…You don't have to look so frustrated about it."
"But wasn't it all a misunderstanding…? Doesn't that make it nothing but a petty resentment directed toward you?"
"It's the same for you, though, isn't it, Sugiura-san? For people who you could call friends as if it were only yesterday to gossip about you…"
"My circumstances are different! It's not a misunderstanding. I really am a traitor, so I'm only receiving my proper punishment."
"…My friends only did what was right. My situation is different from yours, Ogiso-senpai."
"Is that so?"
"It wasn't your fault, Ogiso-senpai… That's why I'm frustrated. The way I am now, I can understand the pain you felt back then."
"Fufu… you really are the person I was told you were."
"Is that so?"

"Although it's the first time we've met, and although I'm only telling you about an old story of mine, you're treating it as if it's your own matter… Rather, you left your own matters aside and really tried to defend me."
"But I couldn't achieve anything. In the end, I'm useless. So there wasn't any meaning in it…"
"You never try to justify yourself. And you never go out of your way to blame others."
"I said that just because it really was my responsibility. It was my fault for not taking action."
"…You're really just like him…"
"Eh?"
"…Alright, then let's move on to something that happened recently."
"O-Okay…"
"Last week… there was a middle school reunion."
"…Did you go?"
"Yeah, I did. There's still a girl who I'm close with up until now, and she said she'd be attending."
"I dressed rather plainly and went out early. I got a little lost, but I ended up arriving there safely. …I discovered that it was a rather large and stylish Italian restaurant."
"But when I tried to go in, my legs were suddenly frozen in place…"
"I wandered around the entrance, walked aimlessly around the area, and looked at the people who went in from a distance."
"…You couldn't go in?"
"Yeah. I didn't know what to do alone. In the end, I gave up after about 30 minutes and headed back to the station."
"Is… that so…"
"Then, someone suddenly tapped my shoulder from behind."
"Ah, was it the only person you were still close with?"
"Unfortunately… it was the leader of the group of friends I used to be in. The girl who had a crush on the boy who confessed to me."
"No way…"
"She saw me from the windows in the restaurant and chased after me."
"Was it because she still harbored ill will toward you, Ogiso-senpai…"
"…From there on, we enjoyed a lively, nostalgia-filled reunion together. It was almost anticlimactic."
"The close group of five all assembled. Everyone mostly remembered what happened in the past, then they started to talk to me one after another."
"…So did they say anything? Did they talk about the falling out they had with you, Ogiso-senpai?"
"Ah, they just went something along the lines of, 'Oh, something like that did happen, huh?'"
"No way…"
"I guess it's aptly put that between the bully and their victim, the bully forgets their actions almost immediately while the victim has to remember everything."
"…And of course, that's exactly what happened. Other than the friend I mentioned, everyone has forgotten all about it."
"…Weren't you angry about that?"
"At first, I was like, 'What the heck?' I've been holding on to it for more than six years. …I even changed my way of life because of it, so what is wrong with them?"
"…Didn't you express that to them?"
"I couldn't…"
"Why not? Aren't you frustrated about this?"
"I was, but above all, I was having so much fun, was so happy, and so filled with nostalgia… In the end, I still really cared about everyone."
"We went to karaoke after that… with only the five of us, ignoring all the guys who tried to invite us."
"I sang five songs in a row and everyone just booed at me without consideration… But in reality, I was the one who was inconsiderate."
"But everyone knew that I love karaoke, so they clapped for me and cheered me on with maracas, reminiscing about the past without even paying attention to the songs…"
"…Look, here's a photo we took there. I exchanged phone numbers with everyone. And we plan to go on a trip next summer."
"…You look like you had fun, Ogiso-senpai."
"I really had a lot of fun. It feels as if I've wiped the slate clean in more ways than one. …I can even say that my life's changed again."
"I see… is that so…"
"It's been six years since then. It's been a really long time. …I've tried my best to make up with them within that period, but I wasn't strong enough for that."
"But I'm glad… I really am."
"…I was pretty certain that someone like you would truly be glad for me."
"Ah… I'm sorry. I just acted as if it happened to me…"
"Don't be. I told it to you so that you could think of it as if you were in my shoes."
"Ah…"
"I wanted to give you hope. …Because I know about your pain very well."
"Ogiso-senpai…"
"What am I saying? Maybe I'm just being pushy about this… I can't guarantee that you'll overcome your predicament smoothly just because I did."
"Not at all… It gave me a lot of courage."
"Thanks. I'm glad you said that."
"Really, you're truly… a kind person, just like I've heard."
"Ah, what was that? You're saying you've heard things about me? Goodness me, what exactly have you learned, if I may?"
"God, what have I been doing all this time? Thinking about how selfish I've been is just making me feel even more miserable…"
"Sugiura-san…?"
"I have to give him back… No, he was never supposed to be mine to begin with, but I have to swear that I just won't do something like that again…"
"U-Umm… Ogiso-senpai… I, actually…"
"Sugiura Koharu-san."
"Don't give up, okay? Be sure to make up with your friends."
"O-Okay… Ah, this isn't the time to talk about that…"
"Well, you did push yourself so far… If it's something you've had to make an enemy of everyone to obtain, it's fine for you to believe that it's something worth fighting for."
"Also, please don't blame yourself like that. Really, you're just as Haruki-kun described you to be. You two are strikingly similar even when it comes to things like this."
"…!? A-Ah… aaa…!"
"That's why you seemed like someone that I would become fond of. Do your best, Koharu-san… Can I call you that?"
"I'm sorry! I'm really so sorry!"
"Could you do me a favor?"
"I heard from Takahiro. Sugiura-san is having her entrance exam today, right?"
"I hear that competition is stiff for that university because they only accept a limited number of applicants? I imagine that it's going to be quite tough, but I hope she'll manage to pass."
"Also, I actually need to ask you for a favor…"
"Could you let me have her for just an hour after her exams are over?"
"Of course, this is only my selfish request. I know how unreasonable it is for me who should not have any connection to you to ask this."
"Even so, I want to talk to her at least once. I want to hear her worries. I want to get to know her."
"I promise I won't cause you any trouble, Haruki-kun. This will be the last time."
"I'll wait for your reply."
I received this text soon after I sent Koharu off.
I immediately replied with the location where Koharu was taking her exam, her schedule, and the place I'd be meeting her. I gave Setsuna the right to wait for Koharu.
I'm sure Koharu will be surprised. She might end up hating me for handing over this spot.
And after she knows the truth… she might lament and blame herself. She might take it all upon herself again.
The truth about how Setsuna and I, on the last day of February, on that snowy day…
On the night before Koharu's graduation ceremony… we had already exchanged our goodbyes.
"Ah…"
"Hm?"
"It's snowing…"
"It really is…"
According to the forecast, it was just a matter of time; the harsh cold outside speaks for itself.
That's why I felt it was all destined to happen. For it to be snowing again.
"I see…"
"Yeah."
"I see…"
Every time I betray Setsuna, the sky brings about falling snow in a merciful attempt to cover up my despicable sin.
…The descent of white, dancing crystals is something that's kind to me alone; and to Setsuna, whose name contains the character for snow itself, it's cruel.
"When Takahiro told us about her, Takeya-kun hung his head, and Io looked like she was about to cry."
"I see…"
"I thought those two were heavily sympathizing with what happened to her, much like I was…"
"They knew… They knew that the university student who ended up separating her from her friends was me."
I said it, I finally said it.
I'm in love with this girl named Sugiura Koharu.
Even when I'd been texting Setsuna, even when I'd exchanged presents with her…
That girl had always been by my side.
"Everything happened because of me. She… Koharu involved herself to protect me."
"And so you feel responsible?"
"Of course I feel responsible… if I'd only gotten a hold of myself… if only I never hurt her friend…"
"If she really hopes for a future where she never met you in the first place, then perhaps you should feel responsible for that, Haruki-kun."
"That's…"
"Did she regret it? Did she ever lament about the fact that she met you, Haruki-kun?"
It's the opposite. She's directly and clearly told me that she never would have wanted that.
"…As I thought. That's why there's no need for you to feel responsible, Haruki-kun. The only thing you have to do is protect the girl you love best."
"Ah… do you know what I'm getting at here? I'm actually being sarcastic."
This isn't just mere sarcasmーit's a merciless interrogation that's cornering the both of us.
"But it's pretty ridiculous of me to be saying such things, right? Considering what I did to you during Christmas…"
"It's not your fault, Setsuna! That's why you don't have to feel responsible!"
"…In other words, Haruki-kun, the girl you love best right now is the girl you truly consider as being the most important to you, regardless of your conscience, sense of responsibility or guilt…"
And it doesn't seem like Setsuna has any intention of tuning down her merciless investigation any time soon.
"So, you should know what to do from now on without asking me, right? You just don't have the time to worry about me anymore with the way things are…"
"Setsuna…!"
Her words sting me as if she's embracing me with swords thrust through her body.
"Do you think I'm terrible?"
"I don't… I don't, but…"
"But you're terrible too, you know, Haruki-kun? …Toward her, that is."
"Eh…"
"Why did you just watch over her? If you had tried to be a busybody from the start like usual, she might not have gone through all these painful things."
"That's…"
It's because I was afraid that things would only become more complicated if I were to get involved.
It's because I had a lot on my plate as well, so I decided not to go out of my way to interfere with matters concerning her school.
It's because Koharu told me that she was alright…
"You don't have to feel responsible. The only thing you need to do is desperately protect the girl you love. You only have to save her…"
She could only look away from her own situation.
After all, Setsuna's been running away from her own situation as well. She's condemning me exactly because she knows how it feels to do that.
"Haruki-kun, you know about what happened to me in the past, right? So you know how I feel about this, right?"
"…Yeah."
Back when she was in middle school…
A single unwanted confession caused cracks to form in her strong bonds and eventually caused them to collapse.
"At that time, if you were there, Haruki-kun, I would've absolutely been clinging to you. …And I wouldn't have ever let go of your hand."

Setsuna's been through what Koharu's experienced up until now, so she just couldn't accept that Koharu wasn't rewarded for what she had to endure. She simply couldn't stand the fact that Koharu had lost everything.
"Then, you know what I wish for now, right? …Please save my middle school self."
"Setsuna…"
…And that's even after she's placed what she's lost on the scale.
"Hey, Haruki-kun."
"…Yeah."
"As of now… who do you want to protect the most?"
"That… That would be… the person who's trying to remain strong and move forward as best she can, despite having collapsed once because of me…"
"Yeah…"
"It's my junior, the girl called Sugiura Koharu."
"Yeah…"
"I won't let her collapse anymore. I won't see her look upset again. …I'll do something about this."
"You finally said it."
At this moment… droplets fell on the table.
"Sorry for saying all these terrible things, okay? …I won't deny that it had a bit of jealousy mixed in it."
Yet those droplets didn't belong to the person who was being hurt by those words, but instead to the person who said them.
"Protect her, okay? Save my past self, okay?"
"I'm sorry… I'm sorry…!"
"You should save those who you can save, alright? After all, my wounds… are no longer within your ability to heal."
"Setsuna… Setsuna…"
"That's right… My wounds are ones that you alone can't heal for me anymore…"
"Only two weeks have passed since then… but I'm already talking about it like it's a distant memory."
"The last day of February… a snowy night…?"
"…Senpai? Your eyes seem red somehow, you know?"
"Well, I didn't sleep last night…"

"The two of us talked about this and decided that we wouldn't tell you about this until your exams were over, Koharu-san. …We didn't want your preparation for your exams to be affected because you suddenly felt responsible for this."
"A-Ah… but that's…"
"The truth is, I think it was a bad idea for us to meet. …I knew that it'd end up being a painful memory."
"I didn't mean for this to happen! Once my exams were over, once the tutoring was over…"
"This is what Haruki-kun chose. He said he loved you best."
"No, it's not like that! It's because I just couldn't let Senpai go no matter what! I just couldn't give him back to you…!"
"That's why you should stay by his side. I can no longer do that."
"Actually, I'm really sorry. I was fully expecting you to attempt to take responsibility for this."
"But… But…"
"Even so, I really wanted to meet you. I really wanted to meet you and talk to you."
"Ogiso-senpai… Why?"
"The first reason is because something delightful happened to me. …So I wanted to share it with the person who's likely to be the happiest about it."
"And that would be…"
"Yeah, about how I made up with my friends. …The truth is, it's the most recent event in my life that I haven't even told my family about, you know?"
"And you shared that… with me?"
"The second reason is because I wanted to cheer you up. Putting aside your relationship with Haruki-kun… you are someone that Takahiro respects."
"Ogiso does…?"

"My brother really chose his words carefully, you know. He said he just couldn't believe that you'd do all those absurd things and expressed his frustration that he wasn't capable enough to help you."
"…But I did do all those things. I even betrayed Ogiso despite the fact that he stood up for me so much."
"He doesn't see it that way, so please don't worry. …After all, I don't see it that way either."
"Even so…"
"We're siblings, and we're quite alike. We're both easygoing, careless… and these traits are exactly why we're so taken by the same kinds of people."
"I'm just kidding. The truth is, my third reason for this is… simply because I was curious about you."
"You were curious…?"
"I wondered what kind of person you are. Someone who's considered to be nearly identical to Haruki-kun with how meddlesome and serious she is… and a very wonderful girl, at that."
"That's all from me. …Sorry I've kept you here for so long."
"I'm not…"
"You'll meet up with Haruki-kun after this, right?"
"No, I…"
"He said he'll be waiting in front of Onjuku Station. I think it's about 30 minutes from here?"
"For me to go where Senpai is…"
"Umm… she will arrive there at around 7 o'clock. I'll take responsibility in sending her there."
"O-Ogiso-senpai…!"
"Okay, sent. With this, everything will be my fault if you don't go there, right?"
"No way…"
"Thank you, Koharu-san. But it's time for you to go. …To where Haruki-kun is, of course."
"It's so cold…"
"What should I do…"
"As I thought, I should talk to him once more. Because… this is… just cruel."
"That was close. I almost ended up letting loose in the middle of that…"
"But it's fine now, right…?"
"I've done what was expected of me, right?"
"As an older sister… and as an ex-girlfriend…"
"I've held this in for two weeks, after all… so it's alright now, right?"
"Well… I should be going now."
"Mhm…"
Even while I was sobbing heavily and couldn't say a word, Setsuna only stared at me kindly.
Her compassionate eyes have given her forgiveness even toward someone as patheticーand as cruelーas I am.
"I've received your payment. Thank you very much."
That's why I could only tuck my tail between my legs and run away.
What I mean to say about Setsuna, who simply couldn't bring herself to blame me…
is that I know that the last sight I had of her will forever be etched in my mind.
The moment I went outside, I reflexively let out a white sigh as I noticed that the snow and the cold were stronger than I expected.
Although I could see the snow from the window next to my seat, it was unexpectedly heavy when I was directly exposed to it, covering my entire surroundings in a pure white.
As I took a step forward, a peculiar high-pitched sound came from my shoes, which could only be heard on days such as these.
Before I realized it, the street was dyed white with snow, which little by little got crushed under the weight of my feet.
But with the way the snow is falling now, I'm sure that the dents I've left with my footsteps will fill up almost immediately.
In other words, and as I thought, there's no longer anything I can do here anymore…
I didn't notice because my gaze has been lowered this whole time.
"Ah…"
I'm currently standing right next to the table we sat at near the window earlier.
Setsuna's waving at me with a smile.
And it's that gestureーthat precise gesture of hersーas well as the kindness she's showing me in her desperate attempt to save me…
That I'll never be able to erase from the deepest depths of my memories.
Not now, and not ever…
"Senpai."
"Ah…"
The big clock in front of the station points exactly at the number seven.
The girl I've been waiting for is now standing right in front of me.
"Senpai…"
"How was the exam?"
"…Senpai."
But my beloved junior's standing completely still in front of me, saying no more than "Senpai" as if she had forgotten how to say anything else.
"…Anyway, good job. Come on, let's go home. I've prepared dinner."
"I will hit you right now, Senpai."
"…Yeah, please do."
"That's why I want you to hit me as well."
"…I refuse."
Obviously, I completely understand why Koharu's saying all this right now.
"Aren't we just terrible…? Aren't we just the worst…?"
"You're right. We are the worst."
…Setsuna truly and completely forgave the two of us.
"To have done something like this to such a wonderful person, to such a kind person… I'm really the worst… I'm such a hopeless bitch."
"Even so… you're still the most important girl in the world to me."
"What were you thinking…? Really, just what were you thinking, Senpai…!?"
"I was thinking about you, Koharu… I was desperately thinking about how I could be your strength."
"You'll regret this. You'll definitely regret this, you know that!?"
"Of course I will."
"I'll regret my decision no matter who I choose… be it Setsuna or you, Koharu."
"Then… Then…!"
"That's why I made a decision that would leave me with only slightly less regrets… I've chosen none other than the girl I love more than anyone else right now."
Koharu didn't hit me. Instead, I felt a powerful thud on my chest.
I hugged the head that hit my chest tightly and pulled her shivering body filled with mixed emotions closer to mine with great force.
"I can only save those that I can save. Setsuna isn't a girl that I can save anymore."
"Why… Why…?"
"Well, I only said this to hide my embarrassment… It's just that, I want to be the strength for the girl I love. That's all."
"Uu-uu… uu…"
"Ah…"
Now that I think about it… I've finally said that phrase.
"After all, you've never even said that you love me."
I've finally said the words that Koharu spontaneously blamed me for never saying back then…
I've finally and unconsciously said these words as if it was completely natural, to the point where she might've not even noticed…
"Koharu… you know… I…"
"I will treasure you… I absolutely will treasure you, Senpai…"
"H-Hey… wait a moment!"
That's exactly what I was going to say… That's without a doubt something I must say…
"I love you, I really love you… I won't let you go."
"I told you, that's…"
But the way a man thinks about these things… wouldn't work on someone as straightforward as Koharu…
"Senpai… Haruki-senpai… Uu-uu… uueee…!"
Compared to the strength Koharu's pouring into her arms that she wrapped around my back, my own embrace around her seems to be lacking.
That's why I hugged Koharu so tightly that she couldn't breathe, determined not to come up short.
"…That's right, Koharu. Please take care of me from now on."
"Yes… leave it to me… Just leave it to me!"
But I'm sure that I'll never be able to win against this girl, no matter how much time passes.
Not now, and not ever…
